## Discussion
explain & justify which dataset(s) to use moving forward

Based on the explorations conducted in Sections 1 to 3, we have decided to focus on the second dataset, ***Key Indicators of Heart Disease (2022)***, for further analysis. This choice was motivated by the fact that the first dataset, *Diabetic Patient Hospital Readmission in the US*, lacked a suitable numeric response variable. The Heart Disease dataset contains a relevant numeric variable `bmi`, as well as several binary and categorical variables, including `phsyical_activity`, `smoking`, and `diabetic`. Within this dataset, we will examine `bmi` as our numeric variable to investigate how BMI varies with lifestyle factors such as physical activity and smoking, and whether higher BMI is associated with the presence of a cardiovascular disease. Additionally, we will analyze `diabetic` as our binary variable to explore whether the presence of diabetes is associated with higher BMI and lifestyle behaviors. Focusing on these variables allows us to address clearly defined, health-relevant research questions while maintainig feasability and interpretability for the remainder of the project.
